near_tie_method: adjacent CE score grouping using 5% of candidate-set CE score range
near_tie_threshold_status: engineering heuristic; not tuned on relevance benchmark
quality_role: secondary tie-break only; cannot cross clear CE relevance tiers
preference_role: explicit preference evidence within relevance-preserving CE tiers
sparse_metadata_policy: missing sparse metadata receives neither reward nor penalty
sentiment_role: explanation/support signal only; not separately added to rating quality
